scientific_integrity: Exact moment formulas, probability limits and their proof are supplied; finite enumeration and seeded Monte Carlo provide checks but are not substitutes for analysis. The expected 2k bound is attributed to the original primary literature. Independent assessment has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Results require independently uniform agent locations on [0,1], truthful reports, a fixed k before n tends to infinity, and an iterated k-limit. No nonuniform or simultaneous-growth limit and no strategyproofness for k>=4 are asserted. Jia full text was inaccessible for complete comparison; publication-priority risks remain.
title: A Dirichlet law and Gaussian welfare scaling for gap-product facility selection
